name: medicare_monthly_enrollment_dashboard
description: Re-implement the Medicare Monthly Enrollment dashboard in an open-source framework that could be deployed to data.cms.gov in the future.
longDescription: An open source re-implementation of the CMS Medicare Monthly Enrollment dashboard, built as a static site with Eleventy and the U.S. Web Design System. The dashboard visualizes the Medicare Monthly Enrollment dataset published on data.cms.gov, which it queries directly from the browser through the public CMS Data API rather than through a bespoke backend. Users can explore national, state, and county level enrollment trends over time, compare Original Medicare against Medicare Advantage and Other Health Plan enrollment, drill from a national choropleth map into the counties of an individual state, and review the underlying figures in an accessible data grid. The project exists to show that the dashboard can be rebuilt with an open source stack and no proprietary dependencies, so that the code, the visualizations, and the accessibility work behind them can be reused by other teams and potentially deployed to data.cms.gov in the future.
